description: A previously usable binding is broken (e.g. the bound folder moved or is unreadable). Durable state is local_workspace_repair_required, so a bind request is rejected with the typed repair_required error until the binding is repaired. The hosted-safe view reports the repair-required readiness without exposing any local path.

error.message: Project binding is broken and must be repaired before binding.

hosted_safe_view.status_message: Local workspace binding needs repair before it can be used.
